violation_type.title: Substitutes, Volunteers and Contractors - Unqualified Not Left Alone with Children (26 TAC §746.1401(f))
violation_type.short_title: Substitutes, Volunteers and Contractors - Unqualified Not Left Alone with Children
violation_type.typical_finding: Observed volunteer left alone supervising a group of children at the time of inspection.

finding_variants.text: Observed volunteer left alone supervising a group of children at the time of inspection.
Observed volunteer in the toddler classroom supervising 5 children 2 years old while they were taking their nap.
There was a contracted individual in direct care of children.  There was no documentation this individual met caregiver qualifications.

At the time of inspection, 2 contractors were observed at the operation providing instruction to school age children without caregiver qualifications. Contractors were alone with children, unsupervised by operation staff.  Contractors  were reported at the operation on a weekly basis.
I observed a volunteer who does not meet caregiver qualifications alone in the infant classroom.
RE-CITE-Observed volunteer left alone supervising a group of children at the time of inspection.
